description_expanded: ABOUT ROYAL PALMS RETREAT: Royal Palms Retreat is a home designed with a great vacation in mind! The house is located in Laguna Beach, between Rosemary Beach and Panama City Beach, directly across the street from a ‘reserved beach' where no development is allowed. Laguna Beach is a small laid-back community away from the congestion of PCB or 30A.The house is a great family gathering place with a bright, open floor plan connecting the kitchen, living room, and dining area. Enjoy outdoor gathering spots including a front porch & a lovely back patio area with a charcoal grill on the 1st floor along with a large 2nd floor balcony. The house is pet-friendly as well. With 2,000+ square feet, there is plenty of space for everyone to be together, have time apart & make great beach vacation memories. Enjoy the beautiful emerald waters of our pristine beaches just a quick 3-minute walk away or relax by the pool next to the house. Sleeping 12, the 3 bedrooms each have a king bed and an ensuite bathroom. On the 1st floor, in addition to the family/living area, there is a spacious king bedroom and bathroom with a walk-in shower. Additionally, there is a comfortable Queen Size memory Foam sleeper sofa in the family room. The spacious 2nd floor master suite has a sitting area and workstation. The large master bath has a double sink vanity, a separate spa/soaking tub and shower. There is a private balcony with a lovely beach view. The other 2nd floor bedroom is an oversized ‘family suite' which has a king bed with 2 sets of bunk beds with a private, attached bathroom with a shower/tub combination. Before you hit the beach or after a long day in the sun, take a short walk down Front Beach Road to Thomas' Donuts for their amazing donuts, ice cream burgers or sandwiches. Be sure to stop into the award-winning Carousel Supermarket and wine store less than ¼ miles from the house. Nearby entertainment includes Pier Park, Shipwreck Island Waterpark, Gulf World, The Hub 30A, Destin Commons, Sandestin Outlet Mall, and much more. There are 3 grocery stores nearby & an endless number of dining options in Panama City Beach, Rosemary and many great options along 30A. ABOUT THE AREA: The West End of Panama City Beach, Florida, is known for its serene and laid-back atmosphere, offering a more secluded and tranquil experience compared to the bustling areas in the heart of Panama City Beach. This area is characterized by its pristine white sandy beaches, crystal-clear emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico, and picturesque natural beauty. Visitors to the West End can enjoy a more peaceful beach experience with fewer crowds, perfect for relaxation and unwinding. The West End of Panama City Beach is home to a variety of charming beachfront communities, upscale resorts, and vacation rental properties, offering visitors a range of accommodation options to suit their preferences. From luxury beachfront condos to cozy beach cottages, there are plenty of choices for accommodations in this area. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the West End's proximity to natural attractions such as Camp Helen State Park and Conservation Park, where they can explore hiking and biking trails, spot local wildlife, and enjoy the beauty of the unique coastal landscape. Water sports enthusiasts can partake in activities such as paddleboarding, kayaking, and snorkeling in the calm waters of the Gulf. For those seeking dining and entertainment options, the West End of Panama City Beach offers a selection of waterfront restaurants, beach bars, and cafes serving up fresh seafood and local cuisine. Visitors can also explore nearby shopping areas, art galleries, and cultural attractions in the surrounding area. Overall, the West End of Panama City Beach is a hidden gem for those looking for a more peaceful and scenic beach experience, away from the hustle and bustle of the busier tourist areas, while still providing easy access to all the amenities and attractions that make Panama City Beach a sought-after destination on Florida's Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Beach access at Malaga Place PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Community Pool * Short walk to the beach * Indoor / Outdoor eating options PARKING: * Free Parking up to 4 Vehicles PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must Be 25 years or older * If you choose to bring your dog(s), there is an additional, non-refundable pet fee of $250 per dog. The fee is to be charged after reservation confirmation. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests. *Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to the properties we manage may go under construction without being notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
